text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Satsuki Sho, everyone has 
been wary of Duramente, desperately 
racking their brains for unconventional 
strategies. Amidst it all, Satono Crown 
calmly formulated her plan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by formidable foes in this dire 
pinch... This is a once-in-a-lifetime 
chance to seize victory and make the 
Satono name known to the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown and the others worked through 
trial and error. Before long, they found a 
breakthrough from past races—
